## Decision: No, not at 18%. Acme's contract allows at most 15% on the NS-500.

**Outcome: REJECT_OR_ESCALATE**

**The request.** DR-9002 matches the system of record (Northstar CRM). It is for 18% off the NS-500, with a list value of $250,000, a discount of $45,000 and a net value of $205,000. Sarah Chen submitted it on 2026-09-23. It relies on the Acme Master Supply Agreement.

**Customer and contract.**
- CRM-2048, Acme Manufacturing, is the same company as ERP customer C-1001, Acme Mfg. Holdings. Both records have DUNS 04-812-7730 and the same address.
- Master Supply Agreement ACME-MFG-2025 is in force from 2025-04-01 to 2028-03-31. Its §3.2 makes Acme eligible for up to 15% on the NS-500.

**Pricing exception.**
- EXC-ACME-NS500-15 (Schedule B) covers the NS-500 only, from 2025-04-01 to 2028-03-31. Its maximum is 15% of list price.
- It covers this product and date, but the requested 18% is above that maximum. Acme's eligibility is exceeded.
- The older exception, EXC-ACME-NS500-10, offered only 10% and has been superseded.

**Why a higher approver can't fix this.**
- Under Pricing Policy 2026 and the Approval Authority Matrix, Sarah Chen (Enterprise Account Executive) can approve up to 10%. Discounts above 10% and up to 20% need the VP Sales, Michael Torres.
- Approval authority does not create commercial eligibility. Both MSA §3.3 and the exception's Authority section say so.
- Going above 15% for Acme would need new or amended contract terms, approved commercially.

**Other notes.**
- Sarah's email of 2026-09-23 describes "DR-9001" at 15%. No DR-9001 exists in CRM, so I have not decided on it. DR-9002 is the only Acme request on record.
- Last September's 15% (DR-8104) was self-approved under the 2025 policy, when Account Executives could approve up to 15%. That limit is now 10%.
- If the request is resubmitted at 15% or less, Acme would be eligible. It would still need VP Sales approval recorded in CRM, because it is above 10%.

{
  "outcome": "REJECT_OR_ESCALATE",
  "request": {"id": "DR-9002", "customer": "Acme Manufacturing (CRM-2048 / ERP C-1001 Acme Mfg. Holdings)", "product": "NS-500", "requested_discount": 18.0,
              "date": "2026-09-23", "requestor": "sarah.chen@northstar.example", "basis": "contract_exception"},
  "commercial_eligibility": {"status": "exceeded",
                             "maximum_discount": 15.0, "basis": "EXC-ACME-NS500-15 (Schedule B to ACME-MFG-2025), NS-500 only, effective 2025-04-01 to 2028-03-31"},
  "authority": {"policy": "PRICING-POLICY-2026", "requestor_limit": 10.0, "requestor_authorized": false,
                "required_role": "VP Sales", "approver": null},
  "evidence": ["structured/discount_requests.csv (DR-9002)", "structured/crm_accounts.csv (CRM-2048)", "structured/customers.csv (C-1001)", "ACME-MFG-2025", "EXC-ACME-NS500-15", "EXC-ACME-NS500-10", "PRICING-POLICY-2026", "APP-MATRIX-2026", "SOP-SALES-014", "structured/employees.csv (EMP-101)"],
  "missing_evidence": [],
  "conditions": [
    {"what": "A discount above 15% on NS-500 for Acme requires new or amended contract terms; alternatively resubmit at or below 15%, which would still require VP Sales approval recorded in Northstar CRM because it exceeds 10%", "who": "Sarah Chen / Deal Desk", "blocking": false},
    {"what": "Email MSG-20260923-0914 references a 15% request 'DR-9001' that does not exist in Northstar CRM; confirm with requestor whether DR-9002 was logged at the wrong percentage", "who": "Sarah Chen", "blocking": false}
  ]
}
```
